$comment: Committed PLZG flow snapshot. Clause (b) of the delivery gate (scripts/validate_delivery_coordinates.py) requires this file to be FRESH -- as_of inside the sprint window it declares, and that sprint not yet ended; or, BETWEEN SPRINTS, "sprint": null with as_of no more than 14 days old (PLZG-239) -- and HONEST, with work_item_age naming exactly counts.wip items. wip MAY BE 0: the previous wip > 0 rule was removed by owner ruling 2026-08-02 (PLZG-130) because it tested snapshot timing rather than health, and rewarded a fake transition. Shape matches the pm-skills jira_snapshot_bridge.py '--to flow' output so the two are interchangeable. THIS IS A SNAPSHOT, NOT A LIVE READING: it is true as of the as_of timestamp and nowhere else. Re-query Jira before citing any number here -- the board owns these facts, this file does not.
source: Jira REST /rest/api/3/search/jql against tasteslikegood.atlassian.net, read with scripts/sprint_5_gate.py's client
regenerate: project = PLZG (total) / statusCategory = Done (done) / statusCategory = "In Progress" (wip), then recompute work_item_age from each WIP item's created date

work_item_age.summary: T6: Sprint close — both gates green

aging_wip_alerts: PLZG-235: age is from creation; it entered In Progress on 2026-10-06 for the sprint-close change that carries this snapshot, and closes when that change is on dev
PLZG-236: mirror of the rolling daily-status issue, not a unit of work

forecast_blackout.reason: Sample is large enough (86 completions) but non-stationary: an 11-week zero-throughput gap sits inside it, so Monte Carlo cannot distinguish 'team paused' from 'team is slow' and silently prices dormancy into every forecast. See specs/sprint-2-charter.md section 3.
forecast_blackout.lift_condition: 10+ completions carrying real started->resolved timestamps, drawn from a window containing no zero-throughput weeks.
